newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hugo Boss sells Joseph & Feiss brands.
newsitem.headline: Hugo Boss sells Joseph & Feiss brands.

text.p: German clothes manufacturer Hugo Boss AG said it had agreed to sell several brands from its U.S. unit Joseph & Feiss Company, generating a marginal increase in its year-end group profit.

In a mandatory statement released late on Monday, Boss said discount retailer Mens Warehouse would take on its Cricketeer, Cricket Club, Country Britches, Joseph & Feiss, Baracuta, Cox & Hawkins, Persuede, Elegante and Futura brands on January 1, 1997.
The sale of the brands would boost its group net earnings for 1996 by "a small single-digit million (mark) sum", Boss said.
Hugo Boss had said in October that it was seeking to dispose of Joseph & Feiss, based in New York.
